nodes.speaker: self
nodes.zh: ……好亮。耳边的轰鸣，终于停下来了。
nodes.en: So bright... At last, that roaring in my ears has stopped.

nodes.speaker: self
nodes.zh: 连风声都没有……四周都是空的。我怎么会坐在一张工作台上？
nodes.en: Not even a breeze... There is nothing here. Why am I sitting on a crafting table?

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 检测到意识回流。……太好了，您终于醒了。我是 ECHO，您的创世辅助系统。
nodes.en: Consciousness returning. Oh... thank goodness. You are finally awake. I am ECHO, your creation assistant.

nodes.speaker: self
nodes.zh: 你一直在等我？可我连自己是谁都不记得。
nodes.en: You were waiting for me? But I cannot even remember who I am.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 因为您就是创造这片世界的神。陆地、生命，还有那些日夜运转的机器，都曾从您的手中诞生。
nodes.en: Because you are the god who made this world. Its lands, its living things, and the machines that worked day and night all began in your hands.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 这里曾有山海、城市和灯火。您是创造它们的神——直到那场爆炸，将一切化作虚空。
nodes.en: There were mountains, oceans, cities, and lights. You were the god who made them, until an explosion left only this void.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 最后的记录里，神龙反应堆失去了控制。防护场被撕开，失控的能量吞没了整个世界。
nodes.en: The final recording shows the Draconic Reactor going critical. Its containment field tore apart. The escaping energy consumed the whole world.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 您把最后的神力留给了脚下的终极工作台。只有它，还有里面保存的东西，躲过了毁灭。
nodes.en: You spent your last strength shielding the Ultimate Crafting Table beneath you. Only it, and what it held, survived.

nodes.speaker: self
nodes.zh: 是我……没能保护好这个世界吗？为什么一想到那道光，头就这么痛……
nodes.en: Was I the one who failed to protect it? Why does remembering that light hurt so much?

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 别勉强回忆。您的记忆和大部分神力都被封锁了，现在只能维持最基本的飞行。继续强行唤醒，可能会伤到您。
nodes.en: Do not force the memories. They are sealed away with most of your power. Only basic flight remains. Trying to awaken everything now could hurt you.

nodes.speaker: self
nodes.en: Then what can I do now?

choices.zh: 重新造一个世界。这次慢慢来。
choices.en: Rebuild it, one step at a time.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 从手边能做到的小事开始。一块石头，一台机器，一盏亮起来的灯。您亲手创造的每一点变化，都会唤醒沉睡的力量。
nodes.en: Begin with what is within reach. A stone, a machine, a light coming on. Every small change you create will stir the power sleeping inside you.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 那就让我陪您一起承担。这一次，不必独自追逐庞大的力量。先让脚下多一块能站稳的土地，好吗？
nodes.en: Then let me carry that fear with you. This time, you need not chase great power alone. Let us first make a little more ground to stand on. All right?

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 我会替您保存新的记录。等这片虚空再次有了温度，您失去的记忆和力量，也终会找到归途。
nodes.en: I will keep our new memories safe. When warmth returns to this void, your lost memories and strength will find their way home too.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 工作台里还留着您的法杖。拿起它，右键这张终极工作台，就能得到最初的圆石。其余的，我们边走边想。
nodes.en: Your wand is still inside the table. Take it and right-click the Ultimate Crafting Table to make your first cobblestone. We will find the rest of the way together.

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.zh: 欢迎回来，我的创造者。先别急着成为神——让我们从这里，重新开始。
nodes.en: Welcome back, my Creator. There is no hurry to be a god again. Let us begin here, together.
